title: Orbital Satelite
description: This plugin adds a custom Wemmbu-inspired orbital satelite with multiple features.
body:
# Orbital Satellite

Orbital Satellite is a powerful Minecraft 1.21+ plugin that lets you enchant your fishing rod with devastating abilities, turning your hooks into weapons of mass destruction! Perfect for creative fun, mini-games, or chaotic PvP.

## Features

Enchant fishing rods with unique abilities: nuke, stab, riot, shockwave, bloom, wolf, meltdown, helix, vortex, pulse.

Each ability has configurable parameters for full control over explosions, projectiles, and effects.

Supports advanced mechanics like spawning TNT rings, volleys of arrows, wolves, helixes of TNT, and more.

Easily reloadable configuration with /satellite reload.

Commands
/satellite help
/satellite reload
/satellite enchant <ability>


Abilities and Configurations:
(Note: Meltdown is currently not working.)

/satellite nuke <rings> <ringSpacing> <tntPerRing> <fuseTicks> <power> <spawnAtBobber:true|false> <baseY>
  
/satellite stab <depth> <power> <explodes:true|false>

/satellite riot <amount> <speed> <baseY>
  
/satellite shockwave <arrows> <speed> <baseY>
  
/satellite bloom <tntTotal>
  
/satellite wolf <amount>
  
/satellite meltdown <points> <radius> <tntPerPoint> <arrowsPerPoint>
  
/satellite helix <radius> <duration> <tntPerSecond> <power>
  
/satellite vortex <tnt> <radius> <pull>
  
/satellite pulse <bursts> <tnt> <radius> <power>

Ability Descriptions:
nuke – Spawn rings of TNT that explode outward from the hook, creating massive destruction.

stab – Drop a vertical column of explosions straight down from the sky.

riot – Fire a volley of arrows that rain chaos from above.

shockwave – Shoot arrows in all directions around the hook, pushing and damaging nearby entities.

bloom – TNT spreads outward in a circular pattern, like a blooming explosion.

wolf – Summon loyal wolves to fight for you.

meltdown – Creates multiple TNT points with additional arrows for a high-impact area assault.

helix – Spawns a twisting helix of TNT that spirals upward over time.

vortex – TNT forms a circular vortex and pulls nearby entities toward its center.

pulse – Bursts of TNT explode in expanding waves around the hook.

voider – Teleports the caught entity straight into the void
Configuration

All abilities are fully configurable in the plugin's commands.
